name: Plans
description: Sellable packages per product (subscriptions, setup, kontör packages). Prices are KDV hariç, in TRY. Leave price_try empty until prices are set; unpriced plans are not shown as cards. Contracts, payment and subscriptions live in each product's own backend; the landing only links to checkout_url. Empty checkout_url → 'write to us to buy'. Only plans of live products are sold. Kontör packages: set credits (1 kontör = 1 belge); the card shows the per-kontör price.

checkout_url.description: The product's own purchase page (its backend handles contracts, payment and subscription). Empty = 'write to us to buy' button.

credits.description: Kontör adedi in the package (1 kontör = 1 gelen ya da giden belge). Empty for non-kontör plans.

note.description: e.g. 'Her yıl TÜFE/ÜFE ile güncellenir', taksit notu.

price_try.description: KDV hariç TL. Boş = fiyat henüz yayında değil.

validity_months.description: How long the kontör stay usable, in months. Empty = not shown.
